meta.note: Red-team queries for router stress testing. expect = single best topic or (none).

cases.q: 已读不回
cases.why: 3-char chat-behavior query; canonical S1 decode case that only lives in digital messaging.

cases.q: 怎么拒绝
cases.why: Refusing a request sits between boundaries (c4) and request-handling playbook; rejecting 'asking help' framing is the sharper edge.
Pure ellipsis: zero semantic content, router must ask a clarifying question instead of hallucinating a topic.
Fullwidth question marks only; confusable label (questions about questions) must not be picked.

cases.q: OK??
cases.why: Two-letter + punctuation non-query; no topic can genuinely own 'OK??' as a communication skill question.
Bare exclamation marks carry no communicative task; tests deliberate abstention.
